context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll features verified: (1) Timeclock shift edit accepts null lunch_start/lunch_end and updates break_minutes, (2) Worksheet totals deduct break_minutes even when lunch fields blank, (3) Multiple shifts same day are summed correctly, (4) mark-paid-in-full creates/updates payment transaction, (5) show_payroll_adjustments toggle in Company Settings saves and controls Adjustments panel visibility, (6) Admin can still edit shifts/transactions after marking paid (no locking).

features_verified.Admin editability after paid: PASS - Shifts and transactions can still be edited after marking paid (no locking)

features_verified.Company Settings payroll section: PASS - Default Payroll Cycle, Pay Week Starts On, Show Payroll Adjustments Panel all present
